''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'' establishes both Mondress and Lostar [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] to be a part of the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]], which the [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] further defines as a sub-region located in the northern section of the Expansion Region. The '''Carvandir system''' was located in the [[Carvandir sector/Legends|Carvandir sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] sub-region<ref name="Outer" /> and the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="Northern Dependencies" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] lay on the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], between the [[Dorin system/Legends|Dorin]] and [[Vaced system/Legends|Vaced systems]]. Another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route connected the Carvandir system to the [[Mondress system/Legends|Mondress system]]. The Carvandir system fell within the borders of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Carvandir system was established in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGtW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' later placed the system in grid square J-7.<ref name="EAOC" />
